note: Round 9 of the Breakdown segmenters (#1241), the planned last tuning round: a fresh real-text sample of 60 (seed 2026102909, rounds 5 to 8's frame) as the headline, a fresh adversarial batch of 10 apart, then the tuning set (round 8's held-out promoted, also round 9's rescore of rounds 6 to 8's real text) and the morphemes sets. jev-1.13.0 at b02e4f429, 3 repetitions, the lab's cached jev transport, no reasoning model, no prompt change during the measurement runs. Strict is contractPass; lenient adds the confirmed noun-or-verb tolerance for a compound's first part. The headline leaves out gerade, the one row the two independent judges split on (contested). Intervals: Wilson on attempts, and a case bootstrap of 20,000 resamples with seed 2026102909.
fixes: Headword form (a718c3ee0, a5354d090, b6c91de67): a word part that is a noun, a name or an adjective has its candidate forms tested with the noun, name or adjective test in the forms request; the letters as they stand win when the test passes them or weighs them highest, else the passing form the headword question weighs most, else its pick. A name's and an adjective's letters before a suffix also offer their umlaut undone (Holländ gave only itself).

Affix inventory (a718c3ee0): -voll joins the suffixes with a noun base (DWDS '-voll · Affix produktiv', Wortzerlegung Mühe -voll). The adverbial -s stays off: DWDS has no affix entry for it and no Wortzerlegung cuts it.

Word + particle adverbs (a718c3ee0, a5354d090, b6c91de67): for a Kind that compounds with no head (ADV, the conjunctions, ADP, PRON...), the sense check asks whether a dictionary's word formation splits the word into two words of their own written together, however far its sense drifted (ADR 0054); its last word may have two letters (zu), and one that is a true particle and a preposition links to its ADP unasked.

verdict: Stop tuning. Real text fell to 76.3% on 59 uncontested cases (Wilson 69.5-81.9%, case bootstrap 64.4-86.4%) against round 8's 80.8%, 7's 84.4% and 6's 89.1%; the intervals overlap, but four fresh samples in a row show no gain, and the pooled rounds 6-9 figure is 82.6% (Wilson 79.7-85.2%, bootstrap 77.7-87.1%). The three fixes hit their targets (geradezu, vielleicht, holländisch, Lederlack, mühevoll 0 -> 3) but the headword test overreached on tuning (seven cases 3 -> 0), and the fresh sample's misses fall in classes no round has fixed: suffix overcuts of bottom words, part routes, and shapes the segmenter lacks.
